name: @checkly-templates/playwright-runner
description: Runs the Playwright-based check kinds (gdpr, xpath-spa, launch-readiness) directly via local Playwright. No Checkly account, API key, or cloud test session — and no dependency on the `checkly` package at all. The ApiCheck kinds (uptime-ssl, redirect, dotnet-health, xpath) are Checkly's own assertion DSL, not Playwright specs, so they're out of scope here; use apps/checkly-runner for those.
